app.RmlyZXN0b3Jl.short_desc.source: Connect to Google Cloud Firestore to manage your NoSQL document database.
app.RmlyZXN0b3Jl.short_desc.message: Connect to Google Cloud Firestore to manage your NoSQL document database.

app.RmlyZXN0b3Jl.desc.source: The Firestore integration enables you to interact with Google Cloud Firestore, a flexible, scalable NoSQL cloud database. Create, read, update, and delete documents, manage collections, and execute queries to automate your document database operations seamlessly.
app.RmlyZXN0b3Jl.desc.message: The Firestore integration enables you to interact with Google Cloud Firestore, a flexible, scalable NoSQL cloud database. Create, read, update, and delete documents, manage collections, and execute queries to automate your document database operations seamlessly.

app.RmlyZXN0b3Jl.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fs.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Firestore** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
